_readme: One entry per asset. Entries with 'source' are built by tools/optimize_media.py (LOCAL only). Entries without 'source' are placeholders: components must render a labelled placeholder box at the given aspect ratio. 'consent' applies to identifiable people. Coordinates in 'crop'/'blur' are fractions [x, y, w, h] of the source frame. Venue context: 8 Jul = bright white room with a large leaf-print wall panel and a yellow GET Academy sun banner (same space as the DAY 1 montage, which also has a beige sofa lounge); 9 Jul = darker wood-panelled room with a long wooden table and a projector screen. Location: Ipoh.

items.alt: A trainer explains a point with both hands while a participant and a young man listen at a workshop table
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright and warm, natural light. Right third: a man in a white short-sleeved shirt, glasses and a beard, seated, gesturing with both hands mid-explanation (sharpest face, looking left). Left third: a woman in a black shirt with long dark hair and glasses, seated, turned towards him and listening. Centre: a young man in a blue denim shirt stands with arms folded, listening. Far right edge: a second young man, partly cut off. Background: a large green monstera/palm-leaf print panel (upper left) and a white banner with the yellow GET Academy sun logo (upper centre); white walls, a ceiling fan. Foreground bottom-left: the corner of a printer/laptop, slightly out of focus. Mood: engaged, mentoring, collaborative. Crop-safe: keep x 0.05–0.95, y 0.10–0.95; for a wide 16:7 banner crop centre on y≈0.45 (all three faces sit between y 0.15 and 0.55). Text overlay works best over the leaf panel (top-left quarter) with a dark gradient.
items.notes: Primary hero still. Trainer identity unconfirmed (could be Ganesh; ask the user).

items.alt: Short silent loop of the cohort seated in a bright lounge during the first day
items.description: 16:9, 15 s, silent loop cut from the edited Day 1 montage. Wide shots of about 6–8 participants seated on a long beige L-shaped sofa around a low wooden coffee table with water bottles, white walls with a leaf-print panel above, plants by a window on the right. Towards the end a man in a light grey blazer at the right end speaks to the group. Calm, attentive mood; little camera motion. Faces are small in frame. Crop-safe: centre 80%. Use as a background loop behind the hero (with dark overlay), autoplay muted, playsinline, loop; show the poster image when reduced-motion is on.
items.notes: Full 4-min montage (621 MB source) is too large for the site: host it on YouTube/Vimeo for the 'Watch highlights' CTA.

items.alt: Programme roll-up banner: Program Persijilan Digital Marketing Strategist, 8th–13th Julai 2024, Ipoh, organised by GET Academy
items.description: Portrait 9:16 roll-up banner graphic (not a photo). Cream background, thin dashed border. Top: Malaysian government crest (small). Centre: bold black uppercase title 'PROGRAM PERSIJILAN DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGIST', then '8th-13th Julai 2024', 'Ipoh', 'Anjuran:' and a yellow square with the GET Academy sun logo at the bottom. Use small, beside the About text, as a programme artefact; it is tall, so constrain height (~420 px).
items.notes: Shows the government crest at the top: if crest use is not permitted, crop it off with crop [0, 0.18, 1, 0.82]. Dates on this file are correct (8–13 Jul). Do NOT use the in-room photo DSC05600 of a different bunting (it says 8th–15th and has a typo).

items.alt: Participants work on phones and laptops around a long wooden table while a slide on naming a Facebook page is projected
items.description: Landscape 3:2, warm indoor light, wood-panelled room. A long wooden table runs from the bottom-left corner to the back. Left side: three to four women in red and teal clothing work on phones and notebooks. Right side: an older man with glasses types on a laptop; a young woman in the foreground right reads a printed sheet. Back centre: a facilitator in a blue shirt sits at a laptop under a projector screen showing a slide titled 'Tips on Naming the Facebook Page'. Table clutter: water bottles, a red handbag, paper cups. Mood: focused, hands-on. Handwritten name cards on the table are blurred. Crop-safe: x 0.0–1.0, y 0.0–0.95; the slide (top centre) is the visual anchor.
items.notes: Journey day 2 + alternative hero. Name cards must stay blurred.

items.alt: A participant smiles while working on a laptop in front of a projected browser screen
items.description: Landscape 3:2, wood-panelled room. Centre: a man with glasses in a blue shirt sits behind a laptop, gesturing with one hand and smiling, a projected browser window glowing on the wall behind him. Lower-left: blurred shoulder of another participant. Mood: practical, discovery. Crop-safe: centre square (x 0.2–0.8) keeps his face and the screen.
items.notes: Curriculum: digital tools / Facebook & Google Ads modules.

items.alt: A participant holds up a smartphone to record content during a workshop
items.description: Landscape 3:2, wood-panelled room, warm light. Centre-right: an older bald man with glasses holds a smartphone up with both hands, framing a shot; a laptop is open in front of him. Background right: other participants at the table, out of focus. Mood: hands-on content creation. Crop-safe: x 0.25–0.95.
items.notes: Curriculum: CapCut video / social content modules.

items.alt: A trainer stands beside a participant who writes on a worksheet
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright white room. Left-centre: a young man in a dark shirt writes on a printed worksheet at a wooden table. Behind him, standing: a man in a white shirt and glasses looks down at the work. Right: an older man in a dark polo, seated, glasses, turned towards them. A coffee mug and a laptop on the table. A white banner with the yellow GET Academy sun logo in the background. Mood: one-to-one coaching. Crop-safe: x 0.05–0.85.
items.notes: Curriculum: strategy / target-customer / positioning worksheets.

items.alt: Two women discuss their notes side by side at a workshop table
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright room. Two women seated side by side at a table, one (left, glasses, dark top) listening, the other (right, dark top) speaking with an open hand. Notebook and laptop in front; a printer in the right foreground. A man is visible through a glass panel in the background. Mood: peer discussion. Crop-safe: x 0.0–0.75.
items.notes: Gallery: Day 1, discussion.

items.alt: A trainer in a white shirt leans in and explains to seated participants
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright room with a staircase behind. A man in a white shirt and glasses stands, leaning forward, explaining with both hands. Bottom-left: the head of a seated participant, out of focus. Mood: mentoring. Crop-safe: x 0.25–0.85.
items.notes: Gallery: Day 1, coaching. Possible trainer candidate.

items.alt: A participant speaks animatedly at the table during a group discussion
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright room. Centre-right: a man in a dark polo with glasses, seated, gestures with one hand while speaking; a coffee mug in front. Left foreground: the blurred shoulder of another participant. Background: two people standing by the door, out of focus. Mood: lively exchange. Crop-safe: x 0.2–0.9.
items.notes: Gallery: Day 1, discussion.

items.alt: A trainer gestures as he talks with a young participant standing beside the table
items.description: Landscape 3:2, bright room, leaf-print panel top-left. Right: a man in a white shirt, glasses and a beard, seated, gesturing while explaining. Centre: a young man in a denim shirt stands behind him. Left edge: another young man stands, partly cut off. A laptop and a phone on the table. Mood: mentoring. Crop-safe: x 0.3–1.0.
items.notes: Gallery: Day 1. Same people as hero-01.

items.alt: The training room set up with a long table, laptops and a projector screen
items.description: Landscape 3:2, wide establishing shot of the wood-panelled room from the doorway: a long wooden table with laptops, bottles and papers, black chairs, a projector screen lit at the far wall. Few or no faces. Darker exposure. Mood: ready to start. Crop-safe: full frame; good as a 'Day 2' header.
items.notes: Gallery / journey Day 2 establishing shot. Slightly dark: lighten in CSS if needed.

items.alt: A facilitator presents to the class beside a projected slide
items.description: Landscape 3:2, wood-panelled room. Centre: a man in a blue long-sleeved shirt stands and presents with one arm raised, a projected slide to the right. Bottom-left foreground: participants and a laptop, out of focus. Mood: energetic teaching. Crop-safe: x 0.1–0.9.
items.notes: Gallery: Day 2, presenting. Possible trainer candidate.

items.alt: Participants relax on a lounge sofa while a colleague stands to chat
items.description: 16:9 still from the Day 1 montage. Left: a man in a dark shirt and a woman in a beige top sit on a beige sofa. Centre-right: a woman in a red-and-white houndstooth top stands, talking to them. Right: potted plants and a leaf-print panel on the wall; bags on the sofa. Mood: relaxed networking during a break. Crop-safe: x 0.0–0.95.
items.notes: Video still. Verify sharpness after export.

items.alt: A participant explains her idea with both hands while others listen
items.description: 16:9 still. Centre-left: a young woman in a striped T-shirt talks animatedly with both hands. Behind her, two women stand listening; pendant lamps and a leaf-print panel in the background. Mood: sharing ideas. Crop-safe: x 0.1–0.9.
items.notes: Video still.

items.alt: A speaker in a light blazer talks one-to-one with a participant
items.description: 16:9 still. Right: a man in a light grey blazer, seated, gesturing while talking. Left: a woman in a red-and-white gingham top listens. Plants and a bright window on the right. Mood: mentoring conversation. Crop-safe: x 0.0–1.0, y 0.0–0.9.
items.notes: Video still. Possible trainer/guest-speaker candidate.

items.alt: Two participants sit cross-legged on a sofa, working through notes together
items.description: 16:9 still. Two young women on the beige sofa, one in a beige top, one in a red T-shirt sitting cross-legged, reviewing notes and talking; bags and a water bottle around them, leaf panel above. Mood: peer learning. Crop-safe: x 0.15–0.85.
items.notes: Video still.

items.alt: A facilitator in a white shirt addresses the group
items.description: 16:9 still, medium close-up. A man in a white short-sleeved shirt and glasses stands against a white wall, speaking with both hands in front of him; a leaf-print panel at the right edge. Mood: confident briefing. Crop-safe: x 0.15–0.7 (subject left of centre).
items.notes: Video still. Possible trainer candidate.

items.alt: A small group works together around a table
items.description: 16:9 still. A small group of three to four participants and an older man seated around a table with black chairs, working together; a staircase and a leaf-print panel behind. Mood: teamwork. Crop-safe: x 0.2–1.0.
items.notes: Video still (near the end of the montage).

items.alt: Ganesh Manokara, lead trainer at GET Academy, seated at a meeting table
items.description: Portrait 4:5 (cropped from a 973x650 landscape original). Ganesh Manokara seated at a dark boardroom table, upper body, turned slightly to his left and looking off-camera with a calm, slight smile. Short dark hair, clear-framed glasses, trimmed beard; light grey blazer over a pink shirt, watch on his left wrist, hands resting on a white document folder. Background: warm light-wood wall panelling and black leather chairs. Foreground: glass water bottles at the bottom edge. Mood: professional, approachable. Face sits at y 0.12-0.40, centred; crop-safe for a circle crop centred at (0.5, 0.3).
items.notes: Supplied by the user on 2026-11-03 for the trainer section. Low-res original (built at about 520x650): ask for a larger file if available. Ganesh may also be the man in the light blazer in the Day 1 montage (gal-v3, hero clip); not confirmed.

items.alt: The Day 1 film: participants and trainers talk about the programme on its first day
items.description: 16:9, 4 min 4 s, with sound. The videographer's edited Day 1 film: participants interviewed on the lounge sofa and around the training table, trainers addressing the group, hands-on work. Plays with controls (not autoplay).
items.notes: Full Day-1 montage with audio, bitrate-capped to stay under Cloudflare Pages' 25 MiB file limit. The six separate vendor interview videos (vendor email 1 Aug 2024) are in the vendor's private Drive: add them here as interview-02.. once a copy is obtained.
